source_readme:
CATHEDRAL F5ZK-B — CH-A1 / CH-A2 / CH-A3 STRAIGHT CHOIR ARCADE + AMBULATORY IDENTITY

SCOPE
Q2-Q5 only.
Q1 lower vaulting remains CH-J / J1 and is not part of this schedule.

APPROVED LOWER / GALLERY VERTICAL STACK
spring Y = 3000
rib/boss crown Y = 4296
upper web crown/reference ~= Y 4394
gallery soffit Y = 4425
gallery floor Y = 4521

The three straight choir lower families intentionally share these datums because
they form one continuous lower storey beneath the gallery. Their architectural
identity is differentiated by actual span geometry, arch apices, profiles,
shared boundary types and bosses rather than arbitrary crown staggering.

PLAN FAMILIES
CH-A1
R0 2933 -> R1 4085
Fixed radial width = 1152
RECT_QUAD

CH-A2
R1 fixed at 4085 -> tapered R2
R2 stations for Q2-Q5:
[5400, 5371, 5343, 5314, 5285]
TAPER_QUAD

CH-A3
tapered R2 -> tapered R3
R3 stations for Q2-Q5:
[6903, 6842, 6780, 6719, 6657]
TAPER_QUAD

PER-BAY HALF-CELL SUMMARY
Q2: half 1872; A1 1152; A2 1315->1286; A3 1503->1471
Q3: half 1728; A1 1152; A2 1286->1258; A3 1471->1437
Q4: half 1584; A1 1152; A2 1258->1229; A3 1437->1405
Q5: half 1440; A1 1152; A2 1229->1200; A3 1405->1372

BOUNDARY ARCH DERIVATION
Transverse doubleau rise:
0.72 x local radial span, rounded to nearest 16.

Longitudinal boundary-arch rise:
0.64 x actual plan-edge length, rounded to nearest 16.

All of these ratios remain above half-span, so the solved two-centered arches
remain genuinely pointed rather than semicircular/depressed.

SHARED LONGITUDINAL ARCHES
R0 inner choir arcade:
176 x 208
Richest lower longitudinal arch.

R1 shared CH-A1 / CH-A2:
160 x 184
ONE physical separator/arcade arch.

R2 shared CH-A2 / CH-A3:
168 x 192
ONE physical separator/arcade arch.

R3 outer wall formeret:
136 x 160
Simplified engaged wall rib.

RIB FAMILY
CH-A1
ogive 144 x 160
intermediate doubleau 152 x 168
major doubleau 160 x 176
boss diameter 288, sculptural drop 176

CH-A2
ogive 152 x 168
intermediate doubleau 160 x 176
major doubleau 168 x 184
boss diameter 304, sculptural drop 192

CH-A3
ogive 160 x 176
intermediate doubleau 168 x 184
major doubleau 176 x 192
boss diameter 320, sculptural drop 208

All three retain the same conservative Gothic moulding language:
central roll/keel, flanking hollows, narrow fillets, downward-facing articulated soffit.

BOSS PLACEMENT
CH-A1 rectangular cells:
plan center.

CH-A2 / CH-A3 tapered cells:
exact intersection of the two actual plan diagonals.
Do not use the bounding-box center.

All bosses are separate objects.
Ogives terminate into the boss collar rather than crossing through each other.

TAS-DE-CHARGE
Y 2616 -> 3000
height = 384
4 courses x 96
No lateral fan.
No easing.
Service centerlines remain vertical below springing.
Controlled overlap only inside the tas-de-charge.

WEB RULE
Raw web/carrier geometry remains authoritative.
No global bulge percentage.
No manual sag correction.
Each severy derives its own ridge from the boss/crown to its local boundary-arch apex.

The upper web reference is approximately Y 4394, only
31 below the gallery soffit Y 4425.
Therefore this lower family does NOT permit unconstrained upward web overshoot.

NEXT
F5ZK-C — AMB-I / AMB-M / AMB-O curved chevet ambulatory architectural identity.
